verdict.rationale: Jules exposes a documented public API with API keys, custom workflows, automation mode, and integrations into tools like Slack/Linear/GitHub, enabling headless/CI-style automation, and community evidence confirms a user built a custom MCP server dispatching tasks via the API. Missing for 10: no first-party CI/CD-specific docs (e.g. GitHub Actions integration guide) or independent benchmarking of headless reliability at scale, and OpenAPI spec probes returned 404.
